title: Meter Shop Standards Table — Meter Tests and Accuracy, Electric Service by Rate Schedule
content:
Meter test terms of Electric Service by Rate Schedule, by schedule:

| Term | R | RS | FH | GS-1 | GS-3 | IR | LP |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Member-requested meter tests free of charge per service account in a rolling 12 months | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| Fee for a test beyond the free allowance when the meter is found within tolerance | $40.00 | $40.00 | $40.00 | $40.00 | $85.00 | $85.00 | $125.00 |
| Accuracy tolerance (percent fast or slow) | 2.00% | 2.00% | 2.00% | 2.00% | 2.00% | 2.00% | 2.00% |
| Largest number of billing periods corrected after a meter is found outside tolerance | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 |
| Under-registration by a slow meter back-billed | No | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

Column key: R is Schedule R Residential Service; RS is Schedule RS Seasonal Residential Service; FH is Schedule FH Farm and Home Service; GS-1 is Schedule GS-1 Single-Phase General Service; GS-3 is Schedule GS-3 Three-Phase General Service; IR is Schedule IR Irrigation Service; LP is Schedule LP Large Power Service.

### Notes

- One member-requested test per rolling 12 months is free on every schedule.
- The test fee is $40.00 on Schedules R, RS, FH and GS-1, $85.00 on Schedules GS-3 and IR, and $125.00 on Schedule LP.
- A meter registering within 2.00% fast or slow is accurate on every schedule, and no more than 6 billing periods are corrected after a meter is found outside that tolerance.
- A slow meter is not back-billed on Schedules R, RS and FH; it is back-billed on Schedules GS-1, GS-3, IR and LP.

### Hypothetical readings

| Test result (hypothetical) | Classification under the 2.00% tolerance |
|---|---|
| 1.80% fast | Within tolerance |
| 2.00% slow | Within tolerance |
| 2.60% fast | Fast beyond tolerance |
| 3.10% slow | Slow beyond tolerance |
